instruction: Insert the three tubes into the rack one by one.

arguments.note: I will turn the right gripper downward to view and grasp the tubes near their capped ends.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 46 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The rotation only partly executed; I will complete the downward viewing pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 28 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will approach the nearest tube's capped end from above, aligning the jaws across its length.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The nearest cap is close to the hand centre. I will lower above it and rotate the jaws across, rather than along, the tube.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 25 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. arguments.note: The wrist view shows the selected tube behind the current grasp point. I will shift toward its cap while staying above the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will centre nearer the upper tube body just below its cap, leaving the long insertion end free.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The upper body is offset toward the right jaw in the wrist view. I will make a small lateral alignment before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws now straddle the body just below the cap. I will lower six millimetres and close gently around it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The gripper has closed around the tube. I will lift it clear before turning its tip downward.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube is securely lifted. I will begin rotating it so its free tip points downward.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will complete the rotation to hold the tube upright for insertion.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The full turn was unreachable at this position. I will move above the rack with clearance, then finish orienting the tube.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: I will straighten the wrist yaw to obtain a more reachable upright carrying pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: With the wrist straightened, I will finish turning the tube upright.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 29 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The tube is nearly upright. I will complete the turn while moving toward the rack with its tip safely raised.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The carrying arm blocks the rack. I will bring the idle wrist above its left side to inspect the tube and slot alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 51 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will finish moving the idle wrist into an overhead inspection view.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: I will use a less steep viewing angle to keep the idle arm reachable.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 35 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will complete the viewing motion so the held tube's axis and rack holes are visible together.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will bring the upright tube above a central rack opening, keeping its tip above the rack for alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The side view shows the upright tube is beyond the rack. I will shift it toward the central openings while keeping the tip raised.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube tip is aligned with a central large opening. I will lower one centimetre toward the rack and check contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The alignment remains steady. I will advance five millimetres into the opening.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will continue the insertion in five-millimetre increments, watching for any displacement or resistance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The descent stopped slightly short, suggesting rim contact. I will lift a few millimetres and shift toward the opening centre.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tip is now closer to the hole centre. I will test a five-millimetre descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The last descent landed without significant error. I will continue another five millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube remains centred over the opening. I will lower another five millimetres to seat it progressively.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will continue the controlled descent by a few millimetres, checking that the tube stays aligned.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will lower another five millimetres while monitoring the tip and rack for contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube has descended into the opening and further travel is meeting resistance. I will release it and inspect whether it remains seated upright.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The released tube remains supported in the rack. I will withdraw the hand before reaching for the next tube.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: One tube is seated upright. I will approach the tube nearest the rack, aiming just below its cap.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 23 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. arguments.note: The first tube has tipped and will need recovery. I will finish aligning above the next tube before attempting another placement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 28 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will centre the jaws on the second tube's upper body and finish the downward grasp orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The previous approach stopped high. I will move slightly toward the tube body and retry the low grasp pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws are around the upper body. I will make a small centring correction, lower to grasp height, and close.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The second tube is grasped near its cap. I will lift it fully clear of the table before reorienting.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The straight lift was unreachable. I will lift in a shorter stage slightly toward the robot.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube is clear of the table. I will begin turning it upright while raising it above rack height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 22 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will align this tube with the back central large opening, offset from the previous unsuccessful placement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 30 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will finish the upright alignment above the selected opening before descending in small steps.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tip is above the central opening. I will lower one centimetre to approach its entrance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will continue into the opening in five-millimetre steps and watch for a seating stop.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube continues downward without a significant pose error. I will advance another five millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will lower the tube another five millimetres, maintaining its current alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will continue the insertion by five millimetres, checking the measured motion against the target.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube remains aligned and is moving freely. I will lower it another five millimetres.

arguments.note: I will continue the controlled insertion by another five millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube has passed the earlier stopping height without resistance. I will lower it another five millimetres toward its seat.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will continue lowering by a few millimetres while checking that the rack and tube stay still laterally.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will lower another five millimetres toward the seated depth, keeping the tube upright.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will advance another five millimetres and check for the tube reaching the rack's lower support.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will lower another five millimetres, stopping if the measured pose indicates contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will continue the slow descent another five millimetres to seat the tube fully.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will lower five millimetres more, checking for the final seating contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will test four millimetres more of descent before releasing the tube.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube has reached a firm seating stop at a deeper position than before. I will release it without moving the arm.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: I will withdraw straight backward from the released tube, keeping the open jaws clear of its cap.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The second tube is now upright in the rack. I will use the left arm to recover the fallen tube on the left side.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The fallen tube is left of the grasp centre. I will align the jaws just below its cap and lower close to grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The upper body is centred. I will align the jaws across the tube, lower six millimetres, and close.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube is securely grasped. I will lift and begin rotating its free end downward in clear space.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will bring the recovered tube upright above the empty opening immediately left of the seated tube.

arguments.note: The recovered tube is clear of the rack. I will complete its upright alignment over the neighbouring opening.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The arms contacted during the approach, so I will avoid further inward travel. I will align over the outer-left opening and release the upright tube into it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will withdraw the open left jaws slightly so the released tube can settle without further contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
